verdict.rationale: Baseten's docs and Truss GitHub repo clearly describe uploading custom/fine-tuned model weights via config.yaml or a Python Model class and deploying them on dedicated GPUs, supporting arbitrary frameworks (transformers, diffusers, vLLM, etc.), and training checkpoints can be deployed directly. However, LoRA adapters specifically are never named, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of adapter-serving workflows. missing for 10: explicit LoRA adapter serving documentation, independent hands-on verification of custom-weight upload.
